name: Sultamicillin
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 375 to 750 mg twice daily; usually 5 to 14 days, continuing 48 hours after symptoms resolve; at least 10 days for hemolytic streptococcal infections
2.25 g (six 375 mg tablets) as a single dose with probenecid 1 g

key_interactions.effect: Raises and prolongs ampicillin and sulbactam levels.
Substantially more ampicillin rashes (IV ampicillin-sulbactam label; applies to the active moieties).

common: Diarrhea (about 3%), rash (under 2%) (IV ampicillin-sulbactam label; applies to the active moieties)
serious: Stevens-Johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis, DRESS

contraindications: History of allergy to any penicillin
monitoring: Kidney function to set dosing frequency

pk.half_life: About 1 hour for both ampicillin and sulbactam (IV label; active moieties)
pk.half_life_eskd: About 5 hours at CrCl 15–29 and 9 hours at CrCl 5–14 (IV label Table 3)
pk.excretion_renal_pct: About 75% to 85% of both excreted unchanged in urine within 8 hours (IV label)

sources.citation: Ministry of Health Singapore. (2026). Unasyn oral tablet 375 mg (sultamicillin tosylate) [SIN04892P; National Drug Formulary product information; last updated October 9, 2026]. Pfizer Private Limited.
